title: Tabula Link Protocol v1 frames
description: Canonical JSON Schema for every TLP v1 frame. docs/PROTOCOL.md explains them; x-tabula-frames lists the frame types.

device_id.description: Random UUIDv4 generated by the device on first launch (lowercase).

command_id.description: Opaque ID chosen by the integration; unique per device for the integration's lifetime (e.g. a ULID).

turn_id.description: Opaque voice-turn ID chosen by the integration; unique per device for the integration's lifetime.

handler_id.description: HA binary handler ID (one byte) that prefixes every PCM frame of the turn (PROTOCOL.md 4.10).

illuminance.description: Ambient light, lux. Omitted until the sensor has reported; never null.

wake_word_active.description: The microphone is open and the wake-word frontend is computing features right now: the setting is on, the permission is held, the service is running and playback is not suspending detection. Always present while the wake_word capability is declared.

last_wake_word.description: Device clock at the last accepted wake-word detection. Omitted until the first detection; never null.

voice_turn.description: listening while the device has an open voice turn and is streaming PCM on the binary channel; idle otherwise. Always present while the voice capability is declared. Speaking is media_state, not this key (ADR 0024).

current_page.description: Frontend path only; query string and fragment are stripped.

state.description: Device state. Every key is optional; a frame carries only keys that changed.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the device supports, including ones this protocol version does not know; the integration ignores unknown ones.

phrase.description: The wake-word phrase the turn began with. Omitted when the turn began without one.

reason.description: command: the integration sent voice_stop. timeout: the device's own turn limit elapsed. error: the microphone or codec failed mid-turn.

ping.description: HA core keepalive command; the device sends it every APP_PING_INTERVAL.

capabilities.description: The device's capabilities that the integration accepts. The device sends only state keys and events these cover.

ack.description: Result for subscribe, state, result, event and log.

error_result.description: HA error envelope. Tabula errors use error_code values; HA may also send its own codes.

command_set_settings.description: Replace the device's settings document (validated against settings.schema.json, P0.5). Revision rules: docs/PROTOCOL.md 4.5.

duration.description: Seconds; 0 keeps it until dismissed. Omitted uses the device setting.

tag.description: A new notification with the same tag replaces the old one.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL without userinfo, or a path resolved against the device's HA base URL. The device never sends its HA token when fetching it.

command_play_media.description: Play an audio URL, e.g. a tts_proxy URL.

position.description: Seconds from the start, for seek.

command_media_control.description: Control audio playback and volume. next and previous need a queue; seek needs a seekable stream (else failed).

path.description: HA frontend path; the device resolves it against its HA base URL and refuses any result off that origin.

command_navigate.description: Load an HA frontend path in the dashboard WebView.

command_go_home.description: Load the start target (dashboard.start_path; HA's default page when none is set).

command_log_subscription.description: Start or stop streaming log lines as tabula/log frames.

command_screenshot.description: Capture the screen and upload it over HTTP (capability: screenshot, Phase 3).

start_stage.description: Pipeline stage the audio joins. stt: the wake word was detected on the device. wake_word: HA's own wake-word engine runs on the stream.

wake_word_phrase.description: The phrase that started the turn, when the device detected one. Absent for wake_word turns.

command_voice_start.description: Open a voice turn and start streaming PCM on the binary channel (capability: voice).

reason.description: ended: the pipeline has the audio it needs. cancelled: a person or automation aborted the turn. timeout: the pipeline gave up waiting.

command_voice_stop.description: Close a voice turn (capability: voice). Idempotent: a stop for a turn that is not open is acknowledged.
